notes.title: update notes feb 10-2021
notes.content:
[b]Some balance changes[/b]
Tower (GUARD) stays longer on the map
Tower reduced AOE range
Bomb (ADVENTURER) Slightly reduced AOE range
Bomb increased time to explosion
Wisp (CONJURER) No friendly fire

[b]Fixes[/b]
flood (WIZARD) now removes inferno fire (ADVENTURER)
added knockback description to help screen
Survival knockback increased on skeletons with few hearts
Survival knockback decreased on skeletons with many hearts
and some other tiny fixes.
